fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Characteristics & Advantages Editor Notes: This program is the key specialty of Zhejiang Province. Software Engineering is a joint program with Bleking Institue of Technology (Sweden) and the key specialty of Zhejiang Province with the support of Zhejiang Provincial Key Disciplines of Computer Software & Theory and Internet of Things Engineering. We also build this specialty by leveraging the strengths from key disciplines of Computer System Architecture and Computer Application Technology of Zhejiang University of Technology, and Computer Network Engineering Research Center of Zhejiang University of Technology. We have a strong faculty team and high-quality experimental facilities, building three subjects including mobile software, embedded system and software outsourcing. We have formed the talent cultivation model with the characteristics of industry-education-research-application integration and refined classification of different cultivation targets. We aim at culturing engineering talents, mainly focusing on guiding students to set up a comprehensive and wide software engineering knowledge framework, strong engineering practice ability and innovative ability. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Main courses include at least 12 courses. Chinese Language, Discrete Mathematics, Data Structure, C++ Programming, Java Programming, Principles of Computer Organization, Principles of Operating System, Principles of Computer Networks, Principles and Applications of Database, Web Application Development, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Software Testing and Quality Assurance, Project Management. 3. Practice Base Editor Notes: After systematic study, students can choose to internshhip in nearly 70 software companies. We have established practice bases in nearly 70 well-known software corporations in China, and build four teaching and experimental bases in cooperation with Hangzhou National Animation Industry Base, Hangzhou National Digital Entertainment Industry Base and several famous companies of large-scale. We also collaborate with famous domestic and foreign universities and research institutes, including Chinese Academy of Sciences and Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics. 4. Employment Information Editor Notes: Graduates are mainly engaged in hi-Tech corporation, public institutions, post and telecommunication departments and financial institutions. The graduates are mainly engaged in theory research, project research & development, application design and engineering management related to software field in new hi-Tech corporation, public institutions, post and telecommunication departments and financial institutions. 5. International Exchange Center (IEC) of ZJUT Editor Notes: CIE is responsible for study affairs and daily life service. International Exchange Center (IEC) of ZJUT is a special department in charge of recruitment, management and education for international students and students from Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan regions, providing: 1）Various Chinese language and culture learning programs 2）Various specialised programs in degree and non-degree studies 3）Arrangement for domestic and international academic conferences 4）Advanced educational facilities and comfortable daily life service 6. Zhejiang University of Technology Introduction Editor Notes: ZJUT is among the top 100 universities in P.R.China. ZJUT employs a high-level faculty and staffs of 2,800, with 800 professors and associate professors, and 4 are members in Chinese Academy of Science and Chinese Academy of Engineering. In recent five or six years over 250 achievements have won national, provincial or ministry awards for scientific innovation and research, among which 11 have won National Awards for Scientific and Technology Progress. Learn More>> 7. Colourful Life Editor Notes: There are a variety of activities international students can choose to take part in. Zjuters Support the 2022 Asian Games ZJUT Volunteers Shined in Hangzhou

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Health certificate (within 6 month). * 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. High School Diploma The documents in other language except Chinese and English shall enclosed with the notarized translated version in Chinese or English. Graduating students can provide pre-graduation Certificate. After admission, the original graduation certificate or notarized copy should be submitted. * 4. Non-criminal record certificate. * 5. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 6. Financial support certificate -Download the template, print it, fill it and ask your financial guarantor to sign and send scan copy . -It has to be filled in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . 7. Study Certificate in China -If you ever study in China, download the form, print it and ask your previous university in China to issue it with Study Certificate and Evaluation(attendance and performance). You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Letter of commitment -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Fill it on computer, print it, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. All the visa pages in passport * 10. Photocopy of passport and all the visa pages. * 11. ID photo White background, 35mm×45mm in size. * 12. High School Academic Transcript The documents in other language except Chinese and English shall enclosed with the notarized translated version in Chinese or English. * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements (1) Applicants must be 18 to 25 years old (inclusive), in good health, and have graduated from high school. (2) All applicants must provide a valid CSCA score report. Please refer to the program catalog for the specific test subjects required by each major download here . 2. Language Proficiency Requirements For English-Taught Programs, applicants must meet at least one of the following criteria: 1) Native English Speaker or English as official language, 2) IELTS 5.5/TOEFL 60, 3) Completion of a high school curriculum where the medium of instruction was English, 4) Other English Language Competence are accepted by our university. 3. Nationality Requirements (In accordance with MOE Document [2020] No.12) (1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport. (2) Former residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan who have emigrated and apply as international students must have obtained their foreign citizenship by April 30, 2022. Additionally, they must provide proof of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (A period of 9 months of actual residence in a year counts as one full year, as evidenced by entry and exit stamps). (3) Applicants who acquired a foreign nationality at birth, and whose parents were both Chinese citizens, or one parent was a Chinese citizen at the time of birth, must meet the following: The Chinese parent(s) must have obtained permanent residency in a foreign country before the applicant's birth. The applicant must provide proof of actual residence abroad for at least two years between April 30, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (A period of 9 months of actual residence in a year counts as one full year, as evidenced by entry and exit stamps). Note: If an applicant's Chinese nationality is confirmed by the Exit-Entry Administration of the Chinese public security authorities during the application, admission, or enrollment process, their application eligibility, admission offer, enrollment qualification, or student status will be revoked.
